description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::Plan' class, which contains business logic for handling project/day plans, including methods to retrieve meals, dishes, ingredients, and project structure for a cooking or meal planning application.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Plan
classes.description: Class implementing business logic for project/day plans, including methods to retrieve meals, dishes, ingredients, and project structure.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Retrieves the list of meals and associated dishes and ingredients for a specific project on a given date.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Retrieves the structured list of days and meals for a project, including associated dishes.

methods.name: project_for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Prepares a simplified structure of the project suitable for editing meals and dishes.

methods.name: resolve_meal_dish_path
methods.description: Resolves a path to a specific dish or meal within a project based on item type and ID.
